answer: An autonomous agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using decentralized cryptographic identity stakes combined with zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent a single attacker from generating millions of fake nodes like a passing comet, the network forces every participant to lock a verifiable stake behind a unique cryptographic cipher. This design transforms governance from a childish fable into a mathematically enforced reality, where operating multiple false identities imposes a catastrophic financial cost of capital immobilization that immediately outweighs any potential network reward.
